[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Incorporate Strength Training: Focus on core, glutes, and legs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Pay Attention to Your Running Form: Maintain good form to reduce injury risk.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Hydrate and Fuel Properly: Drink water and eat a balanced diet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Get Enough Rest and Recovery: Aim for 7-9 hours of sleep.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Mix Up Your Route: Explore new trails to keep runs interesting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Consult a Professional: Consider a running coach for personalized guidance.
